999008199.text:
最後まで残っていた者が勝ちの武道会、か。
獣人限定ならば、参加できるのは俺とイザナと……

localizations.en: A free-for-all tournament where the last one standing wins... If it's beastkin only, that means I can enter, along with Izana and...

999008199.text: 僕もやるよ！　一緒に頑張ろうね、兄さん！

localizations.en: I'll do it too! Let's both do our best, brother!

999008199.text: 最後にティムと俺が残ったら、俺は即降参する

localizations.en: If it comes down to just you and me at the end, I'm forfeiting immediately.

999008199.text:
あんまり露骨だと、
観客のみんなががっかりしちゃわないかな

localizations.en: Won't the audience be disappointed if you make it that obvious?

999008199.text: ティム。お前はなんて優しいんだ

localizations.en: Tim. You're too kind for your own good.

999008199.text:
ランターナ王国騎士団の強さをお披露目する機会！
ハンマーを磨いて準備しないと！

localizations.en: This is my chance to show everyone how strong the Lantarna Royal Knights are! I need to polish my hammer and get ready!

999008199.text:
ふふっ、イザナちゃん張り切ってるなぁ。
私たちも何か力になれないかな？

localizations.en: Hehe, Izana's really fired up. I wonder if there's anything we can do to help?

999008199.text:
武道会の規定を読んだんだけど、
武器とか道具を使ってもいいみたいなんだよねえ

localizations.en: I was reading the tournament rules, and apparently you're allowed to use weapons and items.

999008199.text:
あの国王らしい豪快な取り決めっすわ。
わりとなんでもありだと思っていい

localizations.en: Very much in character for that king. I'd say pretty much anything goes.

999008199.text:
道具がありなら、疲れたとき用に
体力を回復できるものを用意しておこうか

localizations.en: If items are allowed, maybe I should prepare something to restore stamina when they get tired.

999008199.text:
おお、いいんじゃない？　というか調合した道具を
ごっそり持ち込めば楽に勝てるやも

localizations.en: Oh, that's a great idea! Actually, if we load them up with synthesized items, they might cruise to victory.

999008199.text:
あはは……でも、裏を返せば相手も道具を使えるって
ことだし、油断はできなさそう。ひとまず回復かぁ……

localizations.en: Ahaha... But that also means our opponents can use items too, so we can't let our guard down. For now, let's focus on recovery items...

999008199.text:
片手で簡単に食べられて、栄養豊富な携帯食料……
ちょっと考えてみようかな

localizations.en: Something portable and nutritious that's easy to eat with one hand... I'll give it some thought.

999008199.text:
鍛冶屋でハンマーを鍛える道具も買ったし、
あとは……クンクン

localizations.en: I bought some tools at the smithy to work on my hammer, so now I just need to... Sniff sniff.

999008199.text:
ふわぁ、甘くて美味しそうな匂い……
腹ごしらえも必要だね。腹が減ってはなんとやら

localizations.en: Wow, that smells sweet and delicious... I should grab a bite to eat first. Can't fight on an empty stomach, right?

999008199.text:
そこのかわいいお嬢ちゃん。どうだい？
とっても甘いはちみつアイス、試食してみないかい

localizations.en: Hey there, cute little miss. How about it? Want to try a sample of my super sweet honey ice cream?

999008199.text:
ほんと！？　ありがとう！
いただきまーす！！

localizations.en: Really?! Thanks! Don't mind if I do!!

999008199.text:
……あまーい！　でも、甘いだけじゃない？
ちょっと苦いのがあって、でもそれが甘さを……

localizations.en: ...So sweet! But wait, it's not just sweet? There's something a little bitter that makes the sweetness...

999008199.text: これ……ヤバ、なんか、きゅうに、ねむ……

localizations.en: This is... Whoa, suddenly I'm feeling really sleep...

999008199.text:
おや、大丈夫かい？　熱中症かねえ。
ほら、うちで休んでおいき……

localizations.en: Oh my, are you all right? Heatstroke, perhaps? Come on, rest inside for a bit...

999008199.text: くっ……！　だいじょ、ぶ……
あ、イザナちゃ――どうしたの！？　大丈夫！？

localizations.en: Izana! What happened?! Are you okay?!

999008199.text: ……チッ

……ってことがあったんです。
幸いイザナちゃんは無事でしたけど

localizations.en: ...And that's what happened. Thankfully, Izana's all right.

999008199.text:
ごめん、アタシとしたことが浮かれてた……
あのアイスに、なんか入ってたんだ

localizations.en: Sorry, I let my guard down when I should've known better... There was definitely something in that ice cream.

999008199.text:
私たちが聞き込みに行っている間に
そんなことになってたなんて……

localizations.en: I can't believe that happened while we were out gathering information...

999008199.text:
そのアイス売りの女、クロだな。
誘拐の実行犯だ

localizations.en: That ice cream seller is our culprit. She's the one behind the kidnappings.

999008199.text: 今すぐ逮捕しに行きましょう！

localizations.en: Let's go arrest her right now!

999008199.text:
いや、もう遅い。手口が割れた以上
相手は二度と同じ手は使わんだろう

localizations.en: No, it's too late. Now that her method's been exposed, she won't try the same trick twice.

999008199.text:
こっちは武道会で勝ち抜かなきゃいけないのに
行方不明事件も続いてるんじゃ困っちゃうわね

localizations.en: We've got our hands full with the tournament, and now these disappearances keep happening too. This is getting troublesome.

999008199.text:
こちらも王宮に捜査の協力を要求したんですけど
なんだかあんまり反応が良くなくて……

localizations.en: We requested the royal palace's cooperation with the investigation, but they weren't very receptive...

999008199.text:
王のように欲しければ力で奪い取れというお国柄か、
あるいは……

localizations.en: Perhaps it's the culture here—take what you want by force like their king suggests. Or maybe...

999008199.text:
とにかく王宮の支援が期待できない分、
私がいつもの３倍頑張ります！　むんっ！！

localizations.en: Either way, since we can't count on help from the palace, I'll just have to work three times as hard! Here we go!!

999008199.text: それじゃあ、私たちは引き続き聞き込みってことね

localizations.en: Then I suppose we'll continue gathering information on our end.

999008199.text:
はい！　イザナさんの件も気になりますし、
行方不明事件、テキパキ解決しましょう！

localizations.en: Yes! I'm concerned about what happened to Izana, so let's solve these disappearances quickly and efficiently!
